title: Copying one register value
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string, let $k$ be an index from $0$ to $10$, and let $v$ be a vector of thirteen natural-number registers, each at most $4(|x|+1)$. Suppose the register selected as the destination by stage $k$ of the fixed multiplication register program is no larger than the register selected as its source. Starting at stage $k$ of the copy routine with registers $v$ and no answer, the program can reach the stage specified for $k$, with the destination register replaced by the source register's original value, all other registers unchanged, and no answer.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ is an index in the eleven copy stages
